diagnosis.high_profile_observed_direction: Query-first was materially faster in five families; one BTS family was inconclusive.
diagnosis.primary_failure: Synthetic analytic physical-cost rates did not transfer to the real string/checkpoint workload.
diagnosis.workload_limitation: The frozen real-transfer matrix contained no stable policy-first family, so a fixed query-first baseline dominated.

consumption_rule: All six source months and their measured profiles are consumed. They may be used for diagnosis but never again as independent optimizer holdout evidence.
authorized_claim: V3.1 preserved governance legality but failed real-distribution performance transfer.
